actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Deputy action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Deputy connection

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: associate
actions.title: Associate employee
actions.help: Use this action to associate a selected employee with an employee workplace and/or employee agreement in your Deputy instance. If an employee agreement is not provided, Deputy will create a new one for the selected employee.

input.name: employee_id
input.label: Employee
input.hint: The employee in your Deputy instance. Choose from the option listed or manually enter the ID of the employee.

input.name: id
input.label: Employee workplace
input.hint: The employee workplace in your Deputy instance. Choose from the option listed or manually enter the ID of the employee workplace

input.name: intAgreementId
input.label: Employee agreement ID
input.hint: ID of an EmployeeAgreement to assign if it exists for the given Employee. Omit this to create a new agreement.

input.name: blnSetPrimary
input.label: Set workplace as primary
input.hint: If true/1 , set the associated workplace location as primary. Defaults to false/0 .

input.name: intStressProfile
input.label: Stress profile
input.hint: Employee type

actions.name: create_object
actions.title: Create resource
actions.help: Use this action to create a record of the selected resource in your Deputy instance.

input.name: object
input.label: Resource type
input.hint: Select the resource type to be created.

input.name: Employee
input.label: Employee ID
input.hint: User ID. Put 0 if it doesn't matter

input.name: SalesRef
input.label: Sales reference
input.hint: Invoice number or the docket ID

input.name: intUserResponsible
input.label: User responsible ID
input.hint: Assignee ID(User ID)

actions.name: disassociate
actions.title: Unassociate employee
actions.help: Use this action to unassociate a selected employee from an employee workplace in your Deputy instance. To unassociate the selected employee from an employee agreement, use the associate employee action to associate a new one instead.

input.name: employee_id
input.label: Employee ID
input.hint: The employee in your Deputy instance. Choose from the option listed or manually enter the ID of the employee.

input.name: id
input.label: Employee workplace
input.hint: The employee workplace in your Deputy instance. Choose from the option listed or manually enter the ID of the employee workplace

actions.name: get_object
actions.title: Get resource
actions.help: Use this action to retrieve the details of a selected resource using Deputy's resource ID.

input.name: object
input.label: Resource type
input.hint: Select the resource type to be retrieved.

actions.name: search_object
actions.title: Search resources
actions.help: Returns a list of details of selected resources matching the search parameters in your Deputy instance, limited to 500 records at a time. Searches can be performed on any of the fields available in the selected resource. The available set of operators vary depending on the data type of the field sea…

input.name: object
input.label: Resource type
input.hint: Select the resource type to search for.

input.name: intStressProfile
input.label: Stress profile
input.hint: Employee type
